purpose: Hash one existing output file and compare its identity with an expected SHA-256 digest.
trigger: Use after an output file exists at an authorized absolute regular path and its expected digest is known.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Positional path argument: absolute path to one existing output file.

inputs.name: expected_sha256
inputs.description: Positional expected_sha256 argument: expected SHA-256 digest for that file.

preconditions: Call check_output_file_identity(path, expected_sha256) with both arguments positionally.
path is absolute, regular, existing, and has no symlink/reparse component.
expected_sha256 is a valid SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed when file hash equals expected_sha256, otherwise failed.

outputs.name: geometry_verified
outputs.description: Always false; file identity is not geometry verification.

postconditions: The returned hash/status is for this exact path.
geometry_verified remains false and no SpaceClaim/runtime claim is made.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host-side Python helper; it reads one file and never opens or controls SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: Call validation_host_actions.check_output_file_identity(path, expected_sha256) with positional arguments. Invalid path or digest inputs raise ValidationInputError, a ValueError subclass; a hash mismatch returns status=failed. The helper checks file identity only and does not make geometry, save, or runtime claims.

ambiguity_checks: This host helper does not resolve CAD objects or views; the caller must supply the exact path and expected digest.
If the file identity or evidence scope is unavailable, return needs_manual_review rather than infer geometry or runtime state.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The path is relative, missing, nonregular, reparse/symlinked, or the digest is malformed.
failure_modes.detection: check_output_file_identity raises ValidationInputError, which is a ValueError subclass.
failure_modes.safe_state: No pass/fail runtime claim is emitted; preserve the host-only boundary and return needs_manual_review to the caller.

failure_modes.condition: The observed file hash differs from expected_sha256.
failure_modes.detection: The helper returns a flat result with status=failed; it does not replace the expected digest.
failure_modes.safe_state: Retain the failed identity result and do not promote geometry, save, or execution evidence.

recovery.action: Catch ValidationInputError/ValueError, correct the caller-supplied path or digest, and retry only with explicit identity; otherwise return needs_manual_review.
Investigate the exact file and expected digest; do not rewrite the expected hash or infer a successful export.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare its operation ID with the catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and declares one independent validation_visual_review action.

validation.method: Compare the exact positional host-call interface, flat result fields, and ValidationInputError/ValueError boundary with the linked guidance file.
validation.expected: The contract exposes the same fields and preserves needs_manual_review, unsupported-control, and no-overclaim boundaries.

validation.method: Call validation_host_actions.check_output_file_identity(path, expected_sha256) only after the caller has supplied the explicit path and digest.
validation.expected: The returned hash/status is for this exact path.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host property/file checks only. Caller must independently provide trustworthy measured/runtime observations.
